pages.text: Bind a Voodoo Poppet to a target. Sneak-use it with a Bone Needle in your inventory to attempt two magic damage, spending a needle and a charge. The target must be alive and loaded in the same dimension.

Drop a bound Voodoo Poppet into lava to attempt 30 seconds of burning on its target. Each dropped item gets one attempt; the item still burns normally. Player targets respect PvP and team rules, and lava needs an identifiable online thrower.

A bound Voodoo Protection poppet blocks a needle or lava attempt for one charge. Carry it to protect yourself, or store it on a loaded shelf to protect a player or creature. A blocked needle attempt does not consume the attacker's needle or poppet charge.
